evidence: A screen on geography's atlas (4 px/deg hydrostatic fill at 28%) and the turned design years with the refit (GCM output at T21, read from the biome map's cached sums). Lake evaporation carries the storm-water pools' energy-balance result to each cell by its Priestley-Taylor demand; thresholds for nursery, stream, route and salt are design guesses. Distances and passes are good to about a pixel, 7.6 km and the pixel's relief; each hollow takes the climate of a cell of about 29,000 km2.
reading_rule: Heights in metres above the geoid; the lake stands margin_m below the common sea level. today and turned are [lat, lon east in (-180, 180]]; turned follows the frame record's rotation. Ranges are (low, high) across the pools' evaporation. pass_above_sea_m is the lowest ground a channel crosses to the named sea, from the 4 px/deg grid. Candidates are ranked by rank_key.
